intent: One collapsible section of an Accordion, identified by a unique value.
typical_uses: One entry in an Accordion's list of sections, wrapping a trigger and its panel

dont_use_when.rule: A section that must always stay visible and never collapse

invariants.text: `value` identifies this item within its root; it is what `Accordion`'s `value`/`defaultValue` name to control or default which item is open.

anti_patterns.dont: Reuse the same `value` for two items under one Accordion root
anti_patterns.instead: Give every item a unique `value` - see the root's item-values-unique-per-root invariant

assumptions.claim: value is an opaque identifier, typed `any` by Base UI
assumptions.reason: Base UI's Accordion.Item declares `value?: any` - it is compared by identity against the root's `value`/`defaultValue` array and never interpreted, so the primitive types it as anything. Strings are what accordion.md uses, and what a reader should reach for.

assumptions.claim: onOpenChange is a callback, not a value
assumptions.reason: `(open: boolean, eventDetails) => void` - a function of Base UI's own event-details object. No JSON Schema type covers a function.

assumptions.claim: render replaces the item element with one the caller supplies
assumptions.reason: Base UI's render prop takes an element or a function of the item's state; neither is expressible in JSON Schema.

assumptions.claim: style accepts a function of the item's state as well as a plain style object
assumptions.reason: Base UI widens React's `CSSProperties` to `CSSProperties | ((state) => CSSProperties)`; a JSON Schema `object` would reject the function form.

good.title: An item with its trigger and panel
good.code:
<AccordionItem value="item-1">
  <AccordionTrigger>Is it accessible?</AccordionTrigger>
  <AccordionContent>Yes. It adheres to the WAI-ARIA design pattern.</AccordionContent>
</AccordionItem>

bad.title: An item outside any Accordion
bad.why: AccordionItem has no open/close state of its own - it reads and writes the nearest Accordion root's state, so mounting it outside one renders nothing usable.
